name: Nowigence, Inc.
summary: Nowigence, Inc. designs and markets an advanced, AI-driven software-as-a-service (SaaS) platform, engineered to enhance decision-making through sophisticated data discovery, presentation, and forecasting capabilities. Their core offering, Pluaris, continuously collects, organizes, connects, tracks patterns, and displays external market intelligence in real-time. This solution serves a broad spectrum of industries, including manufacturing, services, finance, biotechnology, entertainment, and social studies. The company maintains a strategic collaboration with Orion Business Innovation. Established in 2011, Nowigence, Inc. is headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, with additional presences in Albany, New York; Seattle, Washington; and Noida, India.
